course_name_en: Digital Forensics (not offered in Winter Semester 25/26)
prerequisites: Experience in system-level programming and the C programming language is helpful for understanding the topics taught.

learning_outcomes.text: Students master various concepts, techniques, and tools in the field of digital forensics.
They know the relevant concepts and have an overview of the forensic process.
A basic understanding of various methods for collecting, analyzing, and processing digital traces in IT systems is present.
Students can independently analyze new problems and develop new solutions.
With this understanding, they can discuss computer forensics problems with colleagues and correctly classify emerging issues in conversation.

syllabus_topics: Collection of digital traces in IT systems
Analysis of digital traces in IT systems
Processing of digital traces in IT systems
Methods for recording, analyzing, and processing relevant data in file systems
teaching_methods: Lecture with exercises as a block event
assessment_rules: The prerequisite for participating in the exam is attendance at the block event. Credits are awarded upon passing the exam.
